data.name: Where Evil Sleeps
data.detailed_description:
Your family’s past has already made the choice for you

On August 13, 1992, Nastya arrives in the remote village of Mokhovo, where she once spent her summers with her grandmother. After a failed business venture and mounting debts, she hopes to find money or valuables in the now-abandoned house—something that could help her start over.

The last bus departs, the house turns out to be empty, and all that remains of her grandmother’s former life are old photographs, a strange ring delivered in a parcel, and a children’s storybook with pages torn out.

As darkness falls, the familiar village begins to change. Lights appear in abandoned houses, silhouettes emerge on the roads, and eerie voices drift from the locked basement.

To escape Mokhovo, Nastya must discover what happened there many years ago—and why the past has been waiting for her all this time.

Return to the village of your childhood

Explore Mokhovo, a small Slavic village whose outward tranquillity conceals a long-buried tragedy.

Survive the horrors of your grandmother’s house, neighbouring yards, abandoned gardens, the cemetery, underground passages, forest trails, a sunflower field, and dark labyrinths. Familiar places will gradually distort, revealing new paths, dangers, and fragments of the past.

The objects left behind preserve Nastya’s childhood memories. An old bicycle, family photographs, a piggy bank, toys, and other belongings from her childhood will help you better understand her relationship with her grandmother—and why she stayed away for so long.

Explore, observe, and find a way forward

Search rooms, find keys and tools, collect story-related items, and interact with the environment.

To progress, you will need to:

  • respect local superstitions;

  • hide from possessed villagers or fight them;

  • unlock doors and discover hidden passages;

  • search for the missing pages of an old fairy tale to remember how it ended;

  • solve puzzles connected to the village and its former inhabitants—and much more.

Some answers are hidden in plain sight. Others will reveal themselves only to those who carefully examine their surroundings and notice how they change.

Hide from those who have come looking for you

Most threats cannot be defeated through direct confrontation.

Listen for footsteps behind the walls and choose the right moment to leave your hiding place. Hide beneath beds and tables, sneak past your pursuers, and try not to give yourself away when the enemy is dangerously close.

You will face relentless chases, deadly traps, and creatures born from the village’s fears, curses, and Nastya’s memories.

To survive these encounters, you will need to rely on cunning, the items you find, and the environment itself. A single mistake could be Nastya’s last.

Collect the pages of a forgotten fairy tale

When Nastya was a child, her grandmother used to read her a story about a girl who travelled to a distant fairy-tale kingdom to visit her godmother, a powerful sorceress.

Now the pages of that book are scattered throughout the village.

At first, it seems to be nothing more than an old fairy tale. Yet its events begin to mirror what is happening around you with increasing accuracy, revealing the fates of the villagers and providing clues to the path ahead.

The more pages you find, the harder it becomes to tell where the children’s story ends—and the true past of Mokhovo begins.

Watch the familiar world turn into a nightmare

Your journey begins on a sunny August day among old houses, vegetable gardens, and fields of sunflowers. As night approaches, the village grows increasingly dark and hostile.

The everyday aesthetic of the early 1990s intertwines with rural superstitions, pagan symbols, and surreal body horror.

Buried secrets are still waiting beneath the ground

Who was the woman Nastya remembers as cold and indifferent? Why did the villagers bring her their valuables? Who sent Nastya the ring after her death?

Through memories, environmental clues, pages of the fairy tale, and encounters with the inhabitants of Mokhovo, you will piece together the events that led to the village’s destruction.

Multiple Endings

At the heart of the story lies a choice between the desire for wealth and the chance to leave the past behind.

Nastya’s decisions will shape the final events and lead to different endings. Yet no choice will allow her to completely forget what happened in Mokhovo.

Sometimes evil sleeps deep beneath the ground. Sometimes it waits within a person.

data.short_description: Where Evil Sleeps is a first-person narrative psychological horror game set in a Russian village in 1992. Explore your late grandmother’s house, solve puzzles, hide from pursuers, and uncover what lies beneath the familiar memories of your childhood.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 11 x64
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 3600 / Intel i7-8700K
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 Super / AMD Radeon RX 6600
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 35 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows Compatible Audio Device
  • Additional Notes: Playing on minimum requirements should enable to play on Low settings at 1080p 30fps.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 x64
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 7 5700X / Intel i7-9700K
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3080 / AMD Radeon RX 7800 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 35 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows Compatible Audio Device
  • Additional Notes: Playing on recommended requirements should enable play on High settings at 4K 30fps (using DLSS,FSR or TSR Balanced mode).

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains intense psychological horror, violence, blood, disturbing imagery, corpses, death scenes, and supernatural attacks. Players may encounter hostile human-like creatures, scenes involving burning human figures, imprisonment, and implied cruelty.

The story explores dark themes including family trauma, manipulation, loss, forced choices, and the consequences of past violence. Some scenes may be frightening or emotionally distressing.

The game may also contain brief non-sexual nudity associated with a supernatural creature. There are no sexual acts, sexual violence, or sexually explicit scenes.
